An IPv4 address range with a /16 prefix mask covers **65,536** addresses.

If the range is represented as **X.Y.0.0/16**, it covers all addresses from **X.Y.0.0** to **X.Y.255.255**.

In this configuration, the first two octets (X and Y) are fixed, while the last two octets can range from 0 to 255.
